records.source: :mod:`spacr.counting` is the session: the classes, the markers, the undo stack and the export, all in plain numpy so the tally can be tested without a display. This is the mouse and the panel — a click that lands on a *world* coordinate, a live tally beside the image, and one button that writes the clicks out rather than the total.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.counting` 是会话部分：类别、标记、撤销栈和导出，全部用纯 numpy 实现，因此无需显示器即可测试计数结果。这里则是鼠标与面板部分 —— 落在*世界*坐标上的点击、图像旁的实时计数，以及一个导出各次点击而非总数的按钮。

records.context: Why a click removes as well as adds
records.label: spacr.qt.counting_tool#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Why a click removes as well as adds
records.translation: 为什么点击既能添加也能移除

records.context: A counting session is thousands of clicks and a proportion of them are wrong. The two ways of correcting a mistake are different actions: **undo** takes back the last thing you did, and **clicking a marker again** takes back a specific thing you did some time ago. Both are here, and clicking a marker removes it whatever class it was scored as — a counter who has to re-select the class before they can take a marker back will leave the wrong marker there.
records.label: spacr.qt.counting_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A counting session is thousands of clicks and a proportion of them are wrong. The two ways of correcting a mistake are different actions: **undo** takes back the last thing you did, and **clicking a marker again** takes back a specific thing you did some time ago. Both are here, and clicking a marker removes it whatever class it was scored as — a counter who has to re-select the class before they can take a marker back will leave the wrong marker there.
records.translation: 一次计数会话包含成千上万次点击，其中一部分是错误的。纠正错误的两种方式是不同的操作：**撤销**收回你最近做的一件事，而**再次点击某个标记**收回你在一段时间之前做的某件具体的事。两者在这里都提供，并且无论标记被计为哪个类别，点击它都会将其移除 —— 如果计数者必须先重新选择类别才能收回标记，他们往往会把错误的标记留在那里。

records.context: Not in slice numbers. A slice number describes the file; a position such as ``12.0 µm`` describes the sample and can be checked against the acquisition settings. records.label: spacr.qt.ortho_view#3

records.source: Not in slice numbers. A slice number describes the file; a position such as ``12.0 µm`` describes the sample and can be checked against the acquisition settings. The slider steps by the stack's own voxel size, so dragging it moves one slice at a time and the number it shows is the position of the plane. On a stack with no calibration the unit is ``px`` and the step is 1, so the value equals the slice number.
records.translation: 而不是以切片编号标注。切片编号描述的是文件；而 ``12.0 µm`` 这样的位置描述的是样本，可以与采集设置相对照。滑块以图像栈自身的体素尺寸为步长，因此拖动时每次移动一个切片，显示的数值就是该平面的位置。对于没有校准信息的图像栈，单位为 ``px``，步长为 1，因此数值等于切片编号。

records.context: Why the side panels are not one pixel per slice
records.label: spacr.qt.ortho_view#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Why the side panels are not one pixel per slice
records.translation: 为什么侧面板不是每个切片一个像素

records.context: Because a confocal stack is not isotropic. 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z is an ordinary spaCR stack, and a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin — a picture that does not look broken, just slightly flat, and every 3-D shape read off it is wrong. :meth:`spacr.layers.OrthoViews.covering` gives all three panels one world-units-per-pixel scale, so this module never divides anything by a slice count.
records.label: spacr.qt.ortho_view#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Because a confocal stack is not isotropic. 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z is an ordinary spaCR stack, and a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin — a picture that does not look broken, just slightly flat, and every 3-D shape read off it is wrong. :meth:`spacr.layers.OrthoViews.covering` gives all three panels one world-units-per-pixel scale, so this module never divides anything by a slice count.
records.translation: 因为共聚焦图像栈不是各向同性的。xy 方向 0.65 µm、z 方向 2 µm 是普通的 spaCR 图像栈，而按每个切片一个像素绘制的侧视图会薄三倍 —— 这样的图像看起来并没有出错，只是略显扁平，但从中读出的每个三维形状都是错的。:meth:`spacr.layers.OrthoViews.covering` 为三个面板赋予统一的每像素世界单位比例，因此本模块从不用切片数去除任何量。

records.source: The module shows two results the pipeline computes that would otherwise only be printed to a terminal or left in a module that no screen calls:
records.translation: 本模块显示流程计算出的两项结果，否则这些结果只会打印到终端，或留在一个没有任何界面调用的模块中：

records.context: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds replaces the guess with a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the estimate can be judged.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup, next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds replaces the guess with a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the estimate can be judged.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup, next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main screen.
records.translation: **直径。** :mod:`spacr.diameter` 根据用户自己的少量视野测量对象的特征尺寸，无需加载 Cellpose 或 torch。``diameter`` 是 spaCR 公开的 Cellpose 4 设置中影响最大的一项 —— ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` 会将每张图像缩放 ``30/diameter`` 倍，使对象接近 ``cpsam`` 工作时的尺寸 —— 而它恰恰是用户靠猜测设置的一项。本模块构建的面板用按对象类型的测量值取代猜测，并显示测量了多少个对象，以便评判该估计。它通过 Mask generation 的 Model zoo 弹窗中的 *Measure diameters…* 按钮在独立的弹窗中打开，紧挨着与它互为另一半的模型选择，而不是放在主界面上。

records.context: **Neither one blocks anything.**  The banner is advisory: it never touches the processing session button, never disables it and never intercepts the click, because the user may have reasons to measure a plate that failed QC. :data:`BLOCKS_RUN` is False, ``tests/qt/test_prerun.py`` asserts it against the real screen, and there is no code path here that could change it.

records.source: **Neither one blocks anything.**  The banner is advisory: it never touches the Run button, never disables it and never intercepts the click, because the user may have reasons to measure a plate that failed QC. :data:`BLOCKS_RUN` is False, ``tests/qt/test_prerun.py`` asserts it against the real screen, and there is no code path here that could change it.
records.translation: **两者都不会阻止任何操作。** 横幅仅供参考：它从不触碰 Run 按钮，从不禁用它，也从不拦截点击，因为用户可能有理由测量一块未通过 QC 的板。:data:`BLOCKS_RUN` 为 False，``tests/qt/test_prerun.py`` 针对真实界面断言这一点，而且这里没有任何代码路径能够改变它。

records.context: The banner **reads** a verdict; it does not compute one.  Opening a plate's masks takes seconds to minutes, which is too slow for every visit to the screen.  So :func:`spacr.seg_qc.read_digest` parses the CSVs the mask run already wrote, dates each one against its mask stack, and reports a card older than its masks as out of date instead of using it.  Only the *Score the masks now* button scores anything, only when pressed, and it does it on a background execution unit and writes the card so the next open is cheap again.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The banner **reads** a verdict; it does not compute one.  Opening a plate's masks takes seconds to minutes, which is too slow for every visit to the screen.  So :func:`spacr.seg_qc.read_digest` parses the CSVs the mask run already wrote, dates each one against its mask stack, and reports a card older than its masks as out of date instead of using it.  Only the *Score the masks now* button scores anything, only when pressed, and it does it on a worker thread and writes the card so the next open is cheap again.
records.translation: 横幅**读取**结论，而不计算结论。打开一块板的掩膜需要几秒到几分钟，每次访问界面都这样做太慢了。因此 :func:`spacr.seg_qc.read_digest` 解析掩膜运行已经写出的 CSV 文件，将每个文件的日期与其掩膜栈对照，并把比其掩膜更旧的评分卡报告为已过期，而不使用它。只有 *Score the masks now* 按钮会进行评分，且仅在按下时进行；它在工作线程上运行并写出评分卡，使下一次打开再次变得快速。

records.context: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.translation: 在一台工作站上测得：调用 ``os.path.exists`` 检查 ``/nas_mnt`` 下的某个路径（一个共享处于休眠状态的 ``autofs`` 挂载），二十秒后仍未返回，因为正是 stat 操作触发了自动挂载。此方法过去以内联方式执行这项工作，而 ``install_qc_banner`` 过去在 ``MainWindow._build_screen`` 内调用它，因此每次打开 Measure 时整个界面都会冻结。它没有留下回溯信息，因为停滞的事件循环并不是崩溃；它被报告为 "opening map barcodes crashes spacr"（打开条形码映射会使程序崩溃），同时伴有悬停闪烁和其他界面一闪而过。

records.context: The banner keeps whatever it last drew while a read is in flight. There is deliberately no :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` data-selection boundary in front of the job: the probe answers ``isdir`` optimistically-cheap but the scan has to happen off the main GUI execution path regardless, so a data-selection boundary would only add a first-visit blank for no protection this does not give.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The banner keeps whatever it last drew while a read is in flight. There is deliberately no :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` gate in front of the job: the probe answers ``isdir`` optimistically-cheap but the scan has to happen off the GUI thread regardless, so a gate would only add a first-visit blank for no protection this does not give.
records.translation: 读取进行期间，横幅保留其上次绘制的内容。这里刻意没有在任务前面设置 :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` 门控：探测会以乐观且廉价的方式回答 ``isdir``，但扫描无论如何都必须在 GUI 线程之外进行，因此门控只会增加首次访问时的空白，而不能提供此处尚未提供的任何保护。

records.context: Every call increments ``_refresh_gen``, including a call that finds the microscope field of view empty. That is what makes a read cancellable without being interruptible: nothing can stop the worker mid-``stat``, but its answer is checked against the question before it is painted and dropped when the source has moved on. Without it, clearing src hid the banner and the read still in flight put the old laboratory microplate's verdict straight back on application view under no name at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every call increments ``_refresh_gen``, including a call that finds the field empty. That is what makes a read cancellable without being interruptible: nothing can stop the worker mid-``stat``, but its answer is checked against the question before it is painted and dropped when the source has moved on. Without it, clearing src hid the banner and the read still in flight put the old plate's verdict straight back on screen under no name at all.
records.translation: 每次调用都会递增 ``_refresh_gen``，包括发现字段为空的调用。这使读取可以取消而无需可中断：没有任何手段能在 ``stat`` 进行中途停止工作线程，但其答案会在绘制之前与所提的问题核对，若来源已改变则丢弃。若没有这一机制，清空 src 会隐藏横幅，而仍在进行中的读取会把旧板的结论直接放回界面，而且不带任何名称。

records.translation: 有四个模块带有预览：Mask、Measure、Timelapse 和 Motility。每个预览都需要在 ``AppScreen._build_runtime_panel`` 中写一段十三行的分支、在一个置空代码块中写两个属性名，并在往下两百行处的切换表中加一行。

records.context: This module removes those edits. A module declares a preview here; the strip above the settings form grows a toggle for it; the card is inserted above the processing session row through the same ``_runtime_wrap`` / ``_actions_row`` anchors :mod:`spacr.qt.prerun` uses. Nothing inside ``AppScreen`` changes, and the four previews it already builds are left alone — a module the shared application view has already served is skipped here rather than given a second card.

Nothing inside ``AppScreen`` changes, and the four previews it already builds are left alone — a module the shared screen has already served is skipped here rather than given a second card.
records.translation: 本模块消除了这些修改。模块在这里声明一个预览；设置表单上方的条带会为它增加一个开关；卡片通过同一组 ``_runtime_wrap`` / ``_actions_row`` 锚点（:mod:`spacr.qt.prerun` 也使用它们）插入到 Run 行上方。``AppScreen`` 内部没有任何改变，它已构建的四个预览保持不变 —— 共享界面已经服务过的模块在此处会被跳过，而不会获得第二张卡片。

records.context: A module that has been FOLDED into a host reaches the same machinery from the other end. Its own application view is not built any more, so ``install`` -- which answers for the application view's own key -- can never attach its panel; :func:`attach_folded` lets the host ask for it by name and keeps it hidden behind whatever the host uses to reveal the rest of that module. Mask Generation's tracking switch is the case it was written for.
records.label: spacr.qt.preview_registry#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A module that has been FOLDED into a host reaches the same machinery from the other end. Its own screen is not built any more, so ``install`` -- which answers for the screen's own key -- can never attach its panel; :func:`attach_folded` lets the host ask for it by name and keeps it hidden behind whatever the host uses to reveal the rest of that module. Mask Generation's tracking switch is the case it was written for.
records.translation: 已被并入（FOLDED）宿主的模块从另一端使用同一套机制。它自己的界面不再构建，因此 ``install`` -- 它只响应界面自身的键 -- 永远无法附加其面板；:func:`attach_folded` 让宿主按名称请求该面板，并将其隐藏在宿主用来显示该模块其余部分的控件之后。Mask Generation 的跟踪开关正是编写它所针对的情形。

records.translation: 一个 ``"module:function"``，接受 ``(host, card)``，将面板构建到卡片中并返回面板。给出此项时，通过此注册表附加（ATTACHED）的预览在安装时只构建卡片 -- 调用 ``builder`` 时传入 ``panel_later=True`` -- 并在卡片首次显示或首次请求面板时才构建面板，因此隐藏的预览在模块打开时不增加任何工作量。

records.context: ``emit()`` executes on **whatever independent execution path logged the record** — Python's logging module calls handlers inline. A ConsolePanel answers ``append_stdout`` by *constructing QWidgets* (a topic bar and a text block), and Qt forbids building a QWidget anywhere but the main GUI execution path. Calling the panel straight from ``emit()`` therefore built widgets on a background execution unit; Qt printed ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` and then took the process down. It was reproducible from :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, whose exception path logs a warning from inside the download independent execution path.

records.source: ``emit()`` runs on **whatever thread logged the record** — Python's logging module calls handlers inline. A ConsolePanel answers ``append_stdout`` by *constructing QWidgets* (a topic bar and a text block), and Qt forbids building a QWidget anywhere but the GUI thread. Calling the panel straight from ``emit()`` therefore built widgets on a worker thread; Qt printed ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` and then took the process down. It was reproducible from :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, whose exception path logs a warning from inside the download thread.
records.translation: ``emit()`` 在**记录该日志的那个线程**上运行 —— Python 的 logging 模块以内联方式调用处理器。ConsolePanel 响应 ``append_stdout`` 时会*构造 QWidgets*（一个主题栏和一个文本块），而 Qt 禁止在 GUI 线程以外的任何地方构建 QWidget。因此直接从 ``emit()`` 调用面板会在工作线程上构建控件；Qt 会打印 ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread``，随后使进程崩溃。这可以通过 :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run` 复现，其异常路径会在下载线程内部记录一条警告。

records.context: **GUI-thread relay.** :class:`_ConsoleRelay` is a QObject that belongs to the GUI thread. Its ``line`` signal calls one method on that relay. Qt queues a signal emitted from another thread. Therefore the panel accesses widgets only from their owning thread.
records.label: spacr.qt.verbose_logger#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :class:`_ConsoleRelay` is the fix: a QObject pinned to the GUI thread whose ``line`` signal is connected to its own **bound method**, so Qt queues the delivery whenever the emitting thread is not the GUI thread and the panel only ever touches widgets on the thread that owns them.
records.translation: :class:`_ConsoleRelay` 就是解决办法：一个固定在 GUI 线程上的 QObject，其 ``line`` 信号连接到它自己的**绑定方法**，因此只要发出信号的线程不是 GUI 线程，Qt 就会将传递排入队列，面板只会在拥有这些控件的线程上操作它们。

records.context: Every generated GIF draws its scene inside the same rounded "well" — the 336-pixel frame that :func:`tools.generate_setting_animations._well` paints at (12, 12)-(348, 348) on a 360-pixel black square. The *scene* inside it is usually far smaller than the microplate sample position. Measured across all 94 packaged animations, the median content covers only 63.9 % of the square, 72 of them are below 70 %, and the smallest (``nucleus_diameter``) covers 22.8 %. At tooltip size that leaves a few dozen pixels of actual illustration floating in black.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.animation_zoom#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every generated GIF draws its scene inside the same rounded "well" — the 336-pixel frame that :func:`tools.generate_setting_animations._well` paints at (12, 12)-(348, 348) on a 360-pixel black square. The *scene* inside it is usually far smaller than the well. Measured across all 94 packaged animations, the median content covers only 63.9 % of the square, 72 of them are below 70 %, and the smallest (``nucleus_diameter``) covers 22.8 %. At tooltip size that leaves a few dozen pixels of actual illustration floating in black.
records.translation: 每个生成的 GIF 都把场景绘制在同一个圆角 "well"（边框）之内 —— 即 :func:`tools.generate_setting_animations._well` 在 360 像素黑色正方形上 (12, 12)-(348, 348) 处绘制的 336 像素边框。其中的*场景*通常远小于该边框。在全部 94 个打包动画中测量，内容的中位数仅覆盖正方形的 63.9 %，其中 72 个低于 70 %，最小的（``nucleus_diameter``）仅覆盖 22.8 %。在工具提示大小下，真正的插图只剩几十个像素漂浮在黑色背景中。

records.context: So the frames are not shown as generated. Each animation's real content bounds are measured once — the union, across every frame, of everything that is neither background nor well chrome — and the frames are then cropped and rescaled so the content covers a fixed :data:`TARGET_FILL` share of the square. Animations whose content already overflows that share (the ``remove_border_objects`` scenes reach 91.9 %) are scaled *down* to the same target, so every animation in the app is presented at one consistent size.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.animation_zoom#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the frames are not shown as generated. Each animation's real content bounds are measured once — the union, across every frame, of everything that is neither background nor well chrome — and the frames are then cropped and rescaled so the content covers a fixed :data:`TARGET_FILL` share of the square. Animations whose content already overflows that share (the ``remove_border_objects`` scenes reach 91.9 %) are scaled *down* to the same target, so every animation in the app is presented at one consistent size.
records.translation: 因此帧不会按生成时的样子显示。每个动画的实际内容边界只测量一次 —— 即所有帧中既不是背景也不是边框装饰的全部像素的并集 —— 然后对帧进行裁剪和重新缩放，使内容覆盖正方形中固定的 :data:`TARGET_FILL` 比例。内容已经超出该比例的动画（``remove_border_objects`` 场景达到 91.9 %）会被*缩小*到相同目标，因此应用中的每个动画都以统一的尺寸呈现。

records.context: The measurement decodes and scans every frame, which is far too expensive to repeat on an animation tick — :func:`zoomed_animation` is therefore cached on ``(file, size, target)`` and hands back finished, display-sized frames.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.animation_zoom#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The measurement decodes and scans every frame, which is far too expensive to repeat on an animation tick — :func:`zoomed_animation` is therefore cached on ``(file, size, target)`` and hands back finished, display-sized frames.
records.translation: 测量需要解码并扫描每一帧，开销太大，无法在每个动画节拍上重复 —— 因此 :func:`zoomed_animation` 以 ``(file, size, target)`` 为键进行缓存，并返回已处理好、符合显示尺寸的帧。

records.context: The structured-data name is the frame's *identity*, not its contents: a subset has fewer rows and can genuinely classify differently, so re-deriving for a filtered frame is correct rather than wasteful. ``id()`` alone would be unsound because CPython reuses addresses, so the entry also holds a ``weakref`` and the hit is confirmed with ``is`` — a collected frame cannot produce a false hit, because its weakref resolves to ``None``. The shape is checked too, since a frame can be mutated in place.

The shape is checked too, since a frame can be mutated in place.
records.translation: 键是数据表的*身份*，而不是其内容：子集的行数更少，分类结果确实可能不同，因此为过滤后的数据表重新推导是正确的而非浪费。仅用 ``id()`` 并不可靠，因为 CPython 会重用地址，所以条目中还保存了一个 ``weakref``，并用 ``is`` 确认命中 —— 已被回收的数据表不会产生错误命中，因为它的弱引用会解析为 ``None``。形状也会被检查，因为数据表可能被就地修改。

records.translation: 唯一微妙之处在于弹出面板打开时落在*按钮上*的点击。Qt 把这次按下发送给弹出窗口，因按下位置在其外部而关闭弹出窗口，然后把这次按下重放给下方的控件 —— 也就是按钮，而按钮会立即重新切换为开启。一次点击，打开-关闭-打开，弹出面板看起来就像关不掉。:data:`REOPEN_GUARD_MS` 是忽略该点击被重放的那一半的时间窗口。

records.context: The theme draws every ``QProgressBar`` as an 8 px track (``height: 8px; max-height: 8px`` in :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`). A bar that also paints its own text -- "step 2 of 3", "45%", "312 MB / 690 MB (45%)" -- draws a 13 px caption into those 8 px, so only the top half of each glyph reaches the application view, and at 50 % GUI scale the track is 4 px and almost nothing does. records.source: The theme draws every ``QProgressBar`` as an 8 px track (``height: 8px; max-height: 8px`` in :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`). A bar that also paints its own text -- "step 2 of 3", "45%", "312 MB / 690 MB (45%)" -- draws a 13 px caption into those 8 px, so only the top half of each glyph reaches the screen, and at 50 % GUI scale the track is 4 px and almost nothing does. A caption such as "step 1 of 3" or "10%" is cut off.
records.translation: 主题将每个 ``QProgressBar`` 绘制为 8 px 的轨道（``height: 8px; max-height: 8px``，位于 :mod:`spacr.qt.theme` 中）。如果进度条还自行绘制文本 -- "step 2 of 3"、"45%"、"312 MB / 690 MB (45%)" -- 就会把 13 px 的文字画进这 8 px 中，因此每个字形只有上半部分显示出来；而在 50 % GUI 缩放下，轨道只有 4 px，几乎什么都显示不出来。像 "step 1 of 3" 或 "10%" 这样的文字会被截断。

records.context: Design rules
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#2

records.source: Design rules
records.translation: 设计规则

records.context: **It validates while you type, not when you commit.** The expression is parsed on every keystroke (a parse of a forty-character string is microseconds), so the error message for ``area / perimter`` appears next to the typo rather than after an Add that appears to do nothing. The Add button is disabled until the formula parses *and* resolves against the loaded table.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It validates while you type, not when you commit.** The expression is parsed on every keystroke (a parse of a forty-character string is microseconds), so the error message for ``area / perimter`` appears next to the typo rather than after an Add that appears to do nothing. The Add button is disabled until the formula parses *and* resolves against the loaded table.
records.translation: **边输入边验证，而不是在提交时验证。** 每次按键都会解析表达式（解析一个四十字符的字符串只需几微秒），因此 ``area / perimter`` 的错误信息会出现在拼写错误旁边，而不是在点击一个看似毫无作用的 Add 之后。在公式能够解析*并且*能在已加载的表上解析出列之前，Add 按钮保持禁用。

records.context: **It shows the values, not just the syntax.** A formula can be perfectly valid and produce a column that is 90% infinities, which no amount of syntax checking catches. The preview evaluates the expression over the head of the table and prints :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — so a bad ratio column is noticed before it reaches a chart.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It shows the values, not just the syntax.** A formula can be perfectly valid and produce a column that is 90% infinities, which no amount of syntax checking catches. The preview evaluates the expression over the head of the table and prints :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — so a bad ratio column is noticed before it reaches a chart.
records.translation: **显示数值，而不仅是语法。** 一个公式可能完全合法，却产生一列 90% 为无穷大的值，这是任何语法检查都发现不了的。预览会在表的开头几行上计算表达式，并打印 :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` —— "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" —— 这样错误的比值列在进入图表之前就会被发现。

records.context: A model setting takes a filesystem path, so the user has to know a model exists, find where it lives, and type it correctly. This dialog lists the models in spaCR's catalogue, what each was trained on, whether it is already on this machine, and a button that downloads one and returns its path to the field that opened it.

This dialog lists the models in spaCR's catalogue, what each was trained on, whether it is already on this machine, and a button that downloads one and returns its path to the field that opened it.
records.translation: 模型设置需要一个文件系统路径，因此用户必须知道某个模型存在、找到它所在的位置并正确输入。此对话框列出 spaCR 目录中的模型、每个模型的训练数据、它是否已在本机上，以及一个下载模型并将其路径返回给打开此对话框的字段的按钮。

records.context: The download location is a control rather than a constant. Checkpoints are large -- the Toxoplasma models are 1.2 GB each -- and on a shared workstation or a laptop with a small root volume the default is often the wrong disk. A lab that keeps models on a NAS wants them there once, not once per user. So the folder is on application view, remembered between openings, and shown before anything is fetched rather than discovered afterwards in a full-disk error.

A lab that keeps models on a NAS wants them there once, not once per user. So the folder is on screen, remembered between openings, and shown before anything is fetched rather than discovered afterwards in a full-disk error.
records.translation: 下载位置是一个控件而不是常量。检查点文件很大 -- Toxoplasma 模型每个 1.2 GB -- 在共享工作站或根分区较小的笔记本电脑上，默认位置往往是错误的磁盘。把模型存放在 NAS 上的实验室希望模型只在那里存放一次，而不是每个用户各存一次。因此文件夹显示在界面上，在两次打开之间被记住，并在获取任何内容之前就显示出来，而不是事后在磁盘已满的错误中才被发现。

records.context: The labels and the microplate sample positions share one grid. The column numbers, the row letters and the microplate sample positions all live in a single :class:`QGridLayout`, every item locked to the same square cell, so a column number sits over its column and a row letter beside its row at every window size. The grid takes the width and height its square cells need and leaves the rest to a trailing empty row and column, rather than dividing whatever the window happens to give it -- which is what pulls the labels away from the microplate sample positions they name.

records.source: The labels and the wells share one grid. The grid takes the width and height its square cells need and leaves the rest to a trailing empty row and column, rather than dividing whatever the window happens to give it -- which is what pulls the labels away from the wells they name.
records.translation: 标签和孔共用一个网格。列号、行字母和孔全部位于同一个 :class:`QGridLayout` 中，每一项都锁定为相同的正方形单元格，因此在任何窗口尺寸下，列号都位于其列的上方，行字母都位于其行的旁边。网格只占用其正方形单元格所需的宽度和高度，其余空间留给末尾的空行和空列，而不是分割窗口恰好给出的全部空间 -- 后者正是让标签与其所标注的孔错开的原因。

records.translation: **这里没有任何代码计算结论。** 这条规则来自 :mod:`spacr.qt.prerun`：打开一块板的掩膜需要几秒到几分钟，每次访问都重复这样做太慢了。因此这里的每个读取器只做一次目录列举、一次 stat 和一次解析，然后报告它所发现的内容 -- 包括什么都没找到，而这与没有发现问题并不是一回事。

records.translation: 过期判断遵循同样的规则。``seg_qc.read_digest`` 将每张评分卡的日期与其掩膜栈对照，并把写于掩膜之前的评分卡报告为已过期；本模块将这一结论原样传递到卡片上，而不是重新推导，并对其他来源与其各自的输入应用同样的思路。

records.source: Usable means torch can reach it: a card spaCR cannot run on is not a compatible card however well the driver reports it. records.translation: 可用意味着 torch 能够访问它：spaCR 无法在其上运行的显卡，无论驱动程序报告得多好，都不是兼容的显卡。因此首先询问 Torch，其次询问 NVML，因为即使 torch 构建时未包含 CUDA，NVML 也能报出显卡名称 -- 这正是值得区分的情况，因为此时的答案是 "install a CUDA build"（安装支持该平台的构建版本），而不是 "buy a card"（购买显卡）。

records.context: **the scales are set per panel from that panel's own group**. Every panel's limits are written explicitly rather than left to matplotlib's ``sharex``: sharing makes panels agree with *each other*, but on whatever the first one autoscaled to, which is not necessarily wide enough for the rest. Under :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — the default — every panel is handed the identical tuple, which is a property a test can assert and an eye can trust.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_view#4

records.source: **the scales are set per panel from that panel's own group**. Every panel's limits are written explicitly rather than left to matplotlib's ``sharex``: sharing makes panels agree with *each other*, but on whatever the first one autoscaled to, which is not necessarily wide enough for the rest. Under :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — the default — every panel is handed the identical tuple, which is a property a test can assert and an eye can trust.
records.translation: **标度按面板、根据该面板自身的分组设置**。每个面板的范围都显式写入，而不是交给 matplotlib 的 ``sharex``：共享会使各面板*彼此*一致，但所依据的是第一个面板自动缩放得到的范围，而这不一定足够容纳其余面板。在 :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED`（默认值）下，每个面板都被赋予完全相同的元组，这是测试可以断言、肉眼也可以信赖的性质。

records.source: ``payload['frame']`` is optional: a DataFrame with one row per point, carrying whatever the caller measured. records.translation: ``payload['frame']`` 是可选的：一个 DataFrame，每个点一行，包含调用方测量的任何内容。没有它时，浏览器仍可以识别其点（根据记录的 ``prcfo``），因此仍能发布和接收选择 —— 但针对某个测量列的过滤器在这里没有可检验的内容，会被报告为已忽略，而不是悄悄地把所有点都绘制出来，仿佛过滤器已经生效。
